                   POLICY AND PROCEDURE NOTICE # 11/93




TO:        Distribution

FROM:      Richard C. Visconti, R.A., A.I.A
           Deputy Commissioner

DATE:      September 21, 1993
SUBJECT: Zoning Use Group Designation for Pet Receiving
        Facilities


EFFECTIVE: Immediately.

SPECIFICS: Pet receiving facilities may be classified under Use
Group 6B, Section 32-15 of the Zoning Resolution, similar to
veterinary medicine for small animals, provided all the following
conditions are met:

      1.   The facility only receives small animals, and none will
           be kept overnight.

      2.   All activities are conducted within a completely
           enclosed building and during normal business hours.

      3.   Where the building contains a residential use, no
           access to the facility shall be provided from the
           entrance serving the residential portion.

      4.   Gross floor area of the facility shall be restricted to
           a maximum of 1,200 square feet.
